test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In December 2021, in which city was the National Billiards Championship held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhopal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• In a 5-2 game final played in **Bhopal**, Madhya Pradesh, **Pankaj Advani defeated **his PSPB teammate **Dhruv Sitwala **to win his **11th competition **and successfully defend his **National Billiards Title.**
 
• He competed in the** National Billiards Championship** on behalf of the **Petroleum Sports Promotion Board (PSPB) team.**
 
• The **88th National Billiards Championship 2021** was held at **SAGE University **and was sponsored by the Billiards and Snooker Federation of India (BSFI), which is the national regulatory organization for cue sports in India.
 
• This national sporting occasion is presented by SAGE University in cooperation with the **MP Billiard & Snooker Association **and the **Sports and Youth Welfare Department.**
 
• Given the significance of sports as a pillar crucial to the development of aspirants' careers, there is an infrastructure specifically created for sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• The premier international amateur English billiards event is the** IBSF World Billiards Championship, **formerly known as the** World Amateur Billiards Championship.**
 
• Since **1973**, the International Billiards and Snooker Federation have recognized the event, which has been taking place at least since **1951**.
 
• Before the first **"world amateur" **championship was held in 1951 under the supervision of the **Billiards Association **and **Control Council,** this sport was once known as the **Empire Billiards Championship **(located in London).
 
• After much consideration, the **World Billiards **and **Snooker Council** were founded in 1971.
 
• In **1973**, it changed its name to the **International Billiards & Snooker Federation. **
